# Muhammad Abdullah

> Cybersecurity analyst in Ottawa, working remotely as a SOC analyst for a Canadian cybersecurity firm that serves North American enterprise clients. Two years of alert triage, threat hunting and incident response in Elastic SIEM and Microsoft 365 Defender, including support during an active, threat actor-led ransomware attack, plus IT operations and Python/Pandas log automation. Also designs and builds accessible websites using AI-assisted development. Finishing a B.S. in Remote Sensing & GIS and studying for CompTIA Security+.

## Current role: Cybersecurity Analyst, Ninpo Inc. (Oct 2024 to present, Ottawa, Canada, remote)
SOC analyst for a Canadian cybersecurity firm, handling threat detection, incident response and IT operations across several North American enterprise client environments.

- Incident response: Supported the response to an active, threat actor-led ransomware attack by isolating compromised domain controllers and ESXi hosts before large-scale encryption.
- Threat hunting and triage: Investigates 100+ alerts a week in Elastic SIEM and classifies phishing in Perception Point with 95%+ accuracy. Findings have ranged from compromised VPN credentials to unauthorized RDP lateral movement.
- Detection engineering: Worked with engineering to tune SIEM detection rules, cutting false positives by 20% through baseline behavior analysis and log correlation.
- Endpoint hardening: Audited Elastic EDR health across hybrid environments and fixed hosts where anti-tampering protection had been turned off, reaching 100% telemetry coverage.
- IT operations and Microsoft 365: Administers Microsoft 365 tenants through Pax8, configures VPNs and firewall updates, resolves client support tickets and provisions endpoints for new hires.
- Reporting: Built incident metrics mapped to MITRE ATT&CK, giving leadership clear data on adversary TTPs.

## Other experience
- Product Growth & Strategy, AfterDesk (independent product, Jul 2026 to Aug 2026, remote): Built the product and growth groundwork for an after-sales case manager for small online sellers, including the case workflow, a public site with pilot pricing and a demo, and 37 linked product, architecture, security, API and ethics notes.
- Product Growth Auditor, FitSmart AI (project contribution, Jul 2026, remote): Evidence-based UX and growth review of an AI fitness and nutrition app across nine product areas, with a remediation plan; covered 37 audited icon controls with 18/18 Worker tests passing.
